gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ogh: Dowel-straight and friendly, Nasalization sets bent-dowel arcs against Noto Sans Ogham, whose tall bodies and gaping e look bold. Nasalization earns its keep when it is big and brief.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-ol-: Wire-bent, wide-spaced and friendly. Noto Sans Ol Chiki holds its curve tails back so words read as solid blocks, and a run of text beneath Nasalization feels tidy rather than jagged.
gen-dafont-nasalization-gf-noto-sans-old: Noto Sans Old Hungarian keeps its tall a, e and s open. Noto Sans Old Hungarian handles the small work, leaving Nasalization its stencil-cut, one-width letters for large display.
